current_position.interpretation: The 9 source batches and early moving proofs are preserved. They are inputs to the full repo FX pass, not the final effect treatment. No new base-image batch is required unless QC identifies a specific missing composition.

batches.label: Invocation
batches.story_function: The ritual chamber wakes from near-black. Ember, geometry, smoke and ash gather into the first restrained silhouette of the fire-spirit.
batches.main_media: 10 source images: ember seed -> geometry wakes -> smoke gathers -> incomplete silhouette.
batches.secondary_media: Secondary FX/motion candidates derived from the same Batch 01 world: fire, embers, smoke, glow, localized atmosphere; no new world/identity.
batches.exit_action: Persist all Batch 01 main + secondary media, run small FX gate, record PASS/REJECT per asset and effect, then lock Batch 01.

batches.label: Gathering
batches.story_function: The awakened world answers. Distant ritual presences, circular movement, dust, cloth and torchlight assemble around the same sacred center.
batches.main_media: 10 source images expanding the same world with perimeter figures, circles, dust, torchlight and ritual response.
batches.secondary_media: 10 loop/GIF/motion or FX derivatives from approved Batch 02 source media.
batches.exit_action: FX gate Batch 02, then lock and continue.

batches.label: First Manifestation
batches.story_function: The central spirit gains recognizable identity while remaining one coherent entity; close, mid and wide coverage establish the hero.
batches.main_media: 10 source images establishing the hero identity library across compatible compositions.
batches.secondary_media: 10 motion/loop/FX derivatives preserving exact hero identity.
batches.exit_action: FX gate Batch 03, then lock identity canon.

batches.label: Procession / Passage
batches.story_function: The spirit moves through thresholds, corridors, temple paths and reflective volcanic spaces.
batches.main_media: 10 source images showing forward passage through the same mythic world.
batches.secondary_media: 10 motion/loop/transition derivatives; bounded parallax/camera only after internal motion.
batches.exit_action: FX gate Batch 04, then lock passage coverage.

batches.label: Possession / Peak Build
batches.story_function: The environment becomes fully alive: fire, dust, cloth, smoke, reflected light and ritual energy escalate around the hero.
batches.main_media: 10 source images with the densest ceremonial escalation and strongest controlled visual energy.
batches.secondary_media: 10 FX/motion derivatives emphasizing independent materials and impact without global warping.
batches.exit_action: FX gate Batch 05, then lock peak-build media.

batches.label: Threshold Crossing
batches.story_function: The spirit crosses from the earthbound ritual world into a more mythic plane through fire/water/reflection/gate imagery.
batches.main_media: 10 source images for the crossing and palette/spatial state change.
batches.secondary_media: 10 transition/loop/FX derivatives using reflection, fog, light and bounded depth.
batches.exit_action: FX gate Batch 06, then lock crossing.

batches.label: Apotheosis
batches.story_function: The spirit reaches full mythic manifestation in monumental, iconic compositions.
batches.main_media: 10 apex hero images with wide, mid and iconic silhouette coverage.
batches.secondary_media: 10 FX/motion derivatives with controlled lift, firelight, atmosphere and restrained camera.
batches.exit_action: FX gate Batch 07, then lock apex canon.

batches.label: Release
batches.story_function: Power stabilizes. Motion becomes smoother, less aggressive and more fluid while the same world remains intact.
batches.main_media: 10 source images easing from peak intensity into elevated calm.
batches.secondary_media: 10 subtle living-scene loop/FX derivatives with reduced pulse intensity.
batches.exit_action: FX gate Batch 08, then lock release.

batches.label: Afterglow / Exit
batches.story_function: Ash, horizon glow, smoke and remaining embers settle into transformed stillness.
batches.main_media: 10 closing-source options or fewer only if the repo/user explicitly authorizes a reduced closing batch; default remains 10.
batches.secondary_media: 10 subtle loop/FX derivatives or long-hold variants from approved closing media.
batches.exit_action: FX gate Batch 09, then assembly/proof path.
